notes: Card: peaks on mid-word pieces ('ó', 'á', 'ö', ' sq', 'eh', ' Hin') whose continuation starts with a consonant cluster (rts, lke, cks, rh, pt); the output promotes vowel-less pieces (' mm', ' cm', ' km'). Probes reached only 0.26-0.30 on Icelandic and Spanish words and 0.05-0.12 elsewhere, so the test may miss the 0.20 median. Near misses are the same sentences with unaccented, plainly spelled names.
